subject: Telemetry orchestration & alert stitching — GreenSail
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: ops@greensailhealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: telemetry orchestration & alert stitching for GreenSail

Hi Mike / GreenSail ops team,

Great to connect last week. Following up to start the pre-kickoff alignment so our CS/Implementation team can hit the ground running next Tuesday. High-level asks before the kickoff: 

- Short architecture sketch (where your services sit, ingress points, cloud accounts) — PDF is perfect.
- Existing dashboards (links or exported JSONs) and a prioritized list of 3–5 critical SLOs.
- A short list of the top 10 alerts you currently receive (examples preferred).

Proposed kickoff goals (30–45m): agree on alert taxonomy, initial tracing hook points, and a runbook draft owner. After the meeting we'll deliver a first-pass alert routing matrix and a draft runbook.

I'll loop in Laura (implementation lead) and Ben (CSOps for alert routing). If you can share the artifacts above, I'll drop a quick pre-kick list into a shared Drive and attach any intake templates.

Attachments: pre-kickoff-questions.md (stub)

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

From: Mike Clark <mike.clark@greensailhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@greensailhealth.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry orchestration & alert stitching for GreenSail

Logan — thanks, this looks good. Attaching the architecture PDF (greensail-arch-v2.pdf) and a quick exported list of our top alerts. Answers inline to your asks: 

- Arch: see attached. Primary services run in GCP (us-central1), fronted by a global LB. We have a small on-prem cluster for legacy ETL.
- Dashboards: main Grafana folder is internal-only; I'll export the two dashboards we care about.
- Top SLOs: 1) inference latency P95 < 300ms, 2) availability > 99.9% for public endpoints, 3) nightly batch success > 99%.
- Top alerts: 503 spike on model endpoints, KV cache misses, GPU OOMs on training infra (we'll need separate routing for non-prod).

Attaching: greensail-arch-v2.pdf and a short alerts CSV.

We can do kickoff Tues 11am PT — invite sent.

—Mike Clark
Director, Platform Operations | GreenSail Health
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry orchestration & alert stitching for GreenSail

Thanks Mike — this is perfect. Internal next steps: 

- Laura: you'll own the kickoff agenda + ask for Grafana JSON exports and a read-only service account for basic metric access.
- Ben: can you take lead on a draft alert routing matrix and alert severity taxonomy? Start with the 4 buckets I sketched below (P0/P1/P2/P3) and map the alerts Mike listed. Aim to have a v0 matrix by end of day tomorrow.
- Marissa: please draft a short runbook scaffold that includes paging rules, runbook owner, and escalation play. We'll tailor it to their SLOs.

Mike attached an architecture PDF and an alerts export — copying a couple of lines here for context: 

> 503_spike_model_endpoint, count, high, production
> gpu_oom_training_node, OOM, critical, non-prod

I'll coordinate the Drive folder and post the kickoff invite (11am PT Tue). Ben — I'll forward Mike's CSV to you and add the Greensail folder link.

-Logan

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft alert routing matrix (v0) — GreenSail

Folks — attached is a first-pass CSV (GS-telemetry-requirements.csv) with columns: alert_name, symptom, proposed_severity, primary_route, fallback_route, runbook_link. Notes: 

- I mapped 503 spikes to P0 (page on-call infra + app SRE). Route to PagerDuty: infra_oncall -> fallback: eng-leads email.
- GPU OOM in non-prod -> P2, send to dev-ops channel and create a CR ticket (no page).
- KV cache miss surge -> P1, route to caching owners and send a daily digest if noisy.

Open questions for kickoff: what is their desired noise threshold (counts/5m) and do they want prefix caching alerts suppressed for warmed caches?

Attachments: GS-telemetry-requirements.csv

Ben Carter
CSOps | Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Mike Clark <mike.clark@greensailhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: telemetry orchestration & alert stitching for GreenSail

Mike — thanks again for the quick turnaround and for confirming the 11am PT slot. Short summary before Tues: 

1) Pre-kick artifacts received: architecture PDF (greensail-arch-v2.pdf) + alerts export.
2) Internal deliverables (v0): Ben -> alert routing matrix (attached); Marissa -> runbook scaffold; Laura -> access checklist + kickoff agenda.
3) Items we'll confirm on the call: noise thresholds, alert suppression rules for warmed caches, and whether GPU OOMs in non-prod should flow to a separate non-prod incident queue.

I've added a shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-GS-telemetry. I've also created a HubSpot record for the engagement (HS-004219) and attached the v0 artifacts.

Next: we'll send the calendar invite with a Google Meet link and a short pre-kick questionnaire (one page). If anything changes on your side, ping me and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
